reason: Transitive dev-time dependency via @lhci/cli → lighthouse → puppeteer-core → @puppeteer/browsers. Never runs in production runtime; only touched by Lighthouse CI dev tooling. No fix version published upstream yet (advisory reports fix=<0.0.0). Revisit when upstream ships a patched release or when Lighthouse CI is upgraded.

Same package, same transitive path as CVE-2026-56876 above (dev-time only, via @lhci/cli → lighthouse → puppeteer-core → @puppeteer/browsers — never bundled or run in the production app). This is a Zip-Slip / symlink path-traversal flaw (CWE-22/CWE-59): exploitation requires extract-zip to unzip an ATTACKER-CONTROLLED archive. Our only call site has it unzip Chrome-for-Testing binaries downloaded by puppeteer from Google's own CDN during CI setup — never a user- or attacker-supplied zip. Maintainer is reported unresponsive; a fix landed on the extract-zip GitHub master branch but has not been published to npm as of this scan (fix=<0.0.0). Revisit alongside CVE-2026-56876 when upstream publishes a patched release or Lighthouse CI drops the dependency.

Transitive dev-time dependency via tailwindcss → micromatch/chokidar (used only to glob-match Tailwind's own config `content` paths and watch files during the dev/build process — never bundled into the shipped frontend or exposed to end-user input). This is an uncontrolled-recursion DoS (CWE-674): a deeply nested brace pattern can exhaust the call stack. Our only inputs to braces are developer-authored tailwind.config content globs, never attacker- or user-supplied strings. No fix version exists upstream as of this scan (advisory reports fix=<0.0.0, tracked at micromatch/braces#73). Revisit when upstream publishes a patched release.

Transitive dev-time-only dependency via @playwright/test -> chromium-bidi 14.0.0 (zod ^3.24.1). Never bundled into the production app and never run against user input: chromium-bidi validates BiDi protocol messages from a local Playwright-controlled browser in CI only. No zod 3.x fix exists (advisory fix is 4.x only); forcing zod 4 via resolutions would break chromium-bidi 14's zod-3 API usage and the Playwright jobs. CVE is disputed (OSV: isDisputed true). Revisit when Playwright upgrades chromium-bidi to a zod-4 build.
